titleEn: Ready-made templates on the shared number

ar: اشتغل على الرقم المشترك ومش لاقي قوالب
en: Which templates can I use on the shared number?

steps: A store on the shared number sees the platform's approved service and verification-code templates and its own requests with their status
edgeCases: Only APPROVED utility or authentication templates are listed; never marketing
A store with its own number, or not on the shared number, gets 404
